step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an ad tech user segmentation pipeline divided into INPUT (left) and OUTPUT (right) sections. Data originates from mobile, web, and server clients into an input EKS cluster, which sends logs via Fluentd to raw S3 storage. Lambda cleans raw logs into S3. Athena queries S3 and writes refined 'Gold Data' to a target S3 bucket. DynamoDB and Kinesis collect additional user attributes. On the output side, Admin and Ad Server interact with an evaluation EKS cluster, which queries metadata from RDS, uses Athena to query S3 Gold Data, and writes segment results to DynamoDB.
